title: Legacy imaginary calendar compaction script
user_messages: Let’s reason about an imaginary calendar. Do not use tools or write code. Keep track of the invented names and explain each answer in plain language.
The calendar’s exact reference name is `ORCHID-CLOCK-482`. It has three seasons in this order: Luma, Neri, and Varo. Preserve every invented name exactly.
Each season has a symbol: Luma uses a silver circle, Neri uses a violet triangle, and Varo uses a golden square. Restate the associations as complete sentences.
The calendar holds one celebration in each season. Luma has Lantern Day, Neri has Quiet Day, and Varo has River Day. Describe the full calendar from first season to last.
Without listing everything again, which symbol and celebration belong to the second season? Explain how you identified them.
What was the calendar’s exact reference name? Return it exactly, followed by one sentence explaining what it names.
Add a fourth season named Sora after Varo. Its symbol is a white star and its celebration is Echo Day. Explain how this changes the calendar’s ordering.
Summarize the final imaginary calendar as a numbered list with one season per item.
operator_actions: After user message 4 is answered, manually compact the session.
